requirements.title: LOCK_TYPE has the specified opaque derived-type properties
requirements.definition: LOCK_TYPE is a derived type with private nonallocatable nonpointer components, no type parameters, extensibility, and default initialization for all components.

requirements.title: LOCK_TYPE scalar variables are lock variables with locked and unlocked states
requirements.definition: A scalar LOCK_TYPE variable is a lock variable; default construction represents the unlocked state, all other values represent locked state, and LOCK and UNLOCK statements change the value.
